Create an ISNVFilter object

Source: R/methods.R
ISNVFilter.Rd

Constructs a quality control filter configuration for use with flagISNV.

Usage

ISNVFilter(
  minDepth = 100L,
  minFreq = 0.03,
  maxFreq = 0.5,
  minAltReads = 10L,
  maxStrandBias = 10,
  replicateConc = NULL
)

Arguments

minDepth

Integer. Minimum read depth (default: 100).

minFreq

Numeric. Minimum alt allele frequency (default: 0.03).

maxFreq

Numeric. Maximum alt allele frequency (default: 0.50).

minAltReads

Integer. Minimum alt allele reads (default: 10).

maxStrandBias

Numeric. Max strand bias fold-diff (default: 10).

replicateConc

A ConcordanceRule saying how technical replicates must agree, which flagISNV applies after the other thresholds, or NULL (default) for none.

Value

An ISNVFilter object.

Examples

ISNVFilter()
#> ISNVFilter object
#>   minDepth:      100 
#>   freq range:   [0.03, 0.5]
#>   minAltReads:   10 
#>   maxStrandBias: 10 
#>   replicateConc: none
ISNVFilter(minDepth = 500L, minFreq = 0.05)
#> ISNVFilter object
#>   minDepth:      500 
#>   freq range:   [0.05, 0.5]
#>   minAltReads:   10 
#>   maxStrandBias: 10 
#>   replicateConc: none
ISNVFilter(replicateConc = ConcordanceRule(freqTolerance = 0.05))
#> ISNVFilter object
#>   minDepth:      100 
#>   freq range:   [0.03, 0.5]
#>   minAltReads:   10 
#>   maxStrandBias: 10 
#>   replicateConc: freqTolerance 0.05, requireBothDetected TRUE
